scope: Semilinear GF64 K=C21 semidirect C2, all normalized two noninvolutory inverse pairs plus two involutions, types I and II
best_full_score_scope: Only BB-passing candidates receive full three-root BFS; rejected candidates have no claimed full-score minimum.
root_zero_scope: Counts and component minima are among BB-passing, fully scored candidates. Joint head+block-zero=0 also holds for the complete normalized range by HH/BB necessary-condition failures.

best_bad_pair_types_derived.method: Derived from independently verified root misses (24,30,0), exact BB coverage, orbit sizes, transitivity and undirected double-counting; no additional BFS.
